name: Boon Keng
summary: NEL mid-town pocket between Kallang and Potong Pasir — practical condo/HDB mix with CTE-adjacent hops and less tourist gloss than Bugis.
body: Boon Keng is the shortlist when North-East Line mid-town access and quieter residential texture matter more than riverside nightlife branding. The station pocket sits between Kallang lifestyle gravity and Potong Pasir’s older estate feel; housing mixes HDB slabs with selective condo edges. Expats land here for manageable CBD hops and car-light errands without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: peak NEL congestion, older-block ops, and estate-specific CCTV / visitor-app culture. Compare with Sennett for landed-adjacent calm, Geylang East for food-spine energy, and Kallang when stadium / riverside living wins.
